title: 郭守敬编制《授时历》
summary: 郭守敬在全国设27个观测站，编制《授时历》以365.2425天为一年，与现行公历相同但早了三个世纪。
summaryEn: Guo Shoujing set up 27 observatories nationwide and created the Shoushi Calendar, matching the Gregorian year length three centuries earlier.
description: 郭守敬在全国设27个观测站，编制《授时历》以365.2425天为一年，与现行公历相同但早了三个世纪。
descriptionEn: Guo Shoujing set up 27 observatories nationwide and created the Shoushi Calendar, matching the Gregorian year length three centuries earlier.

title: 郭守敬修建通惠河
summary: 郭守敬主持修建通惠河，使京杭大运河全线贯通直达大都城内的积水潭。
summaryEn: Guo Shoujing built the Tonghui Canal, completing the Grand Canal's direct connection to the heart of Dadu.
description: 郭守敬主持修建通惠河，使京杭大运河全线贯通直达大都城内的积水潭。
descriptionEn: Guo Shoujing built the Tonghui Canal, completing the Grand Canal's direct connection to the heart of Dadu.

title: 元成宗守成之治
summary: 忽必烈之孙铁穆耳继承皇位，停止对外远征，基本维持忽必烈的制度框架。
summaryEn: Temur, Kublai's grandson, halted foreign expeditions and maintained Kublai's institutional framework.
description: 忽必烈之孙铁穆耳继承皇位，停止对外远征，基本维持忽必烈的制度框架。
descriptionEn: Temur, Kublai's grandson, halted foreign expeditions and maintained Kublai's institutional framework.

title: 元惠宗——元朝末代皇帝
summary: 妥懽帖睦尔年少即位，初期励精图治但很快沉迷享乐。1368年徐达攻入大都，元朝在中原的统治终结。
summaryEn: Toghon Temur ascended young; after brief reform, he indulged in pleasure. In 1368, Xu Da captured Dadu, ending Yuan rule in China.
description: 妥懽帖睦尔年少即位，初期励精图治但很快沉迷享乐。1368年徐达攻入大都，元朝在中原的统治终结。
descriptionEn: Toghon Temur ascended young; after brief reform, he indulged in pleasure. In 1368, Xu Da captured Dadu, ending Yuan rule in China.

title: 刘伯温辅佐朱元璋
summary: 刘伯温是明朝开国第一谋臣，以神机妙算著称，民间传说中近乎半神化的军师形象。
summaryEn: Liu Bowen was the founding Ming dynasty's foremost strategist, mythologized in folklore as a semi-divine advisor.
description: 刘伯温是明朝开国第一谋臣，以神机妙算著称，民间传说中近乎半神化的军师形象。
descriptionEn: Liu Bowen was the founding Ming dynasty's foremost strategist, mythologized in folklore as a semi-divine advisor.

title: 靖难之役
summary: 燕王朱棣以「清君侧」为名发动靖难之役，四年后攻入南京夺取皇位。
summaryEn: Prince of Yan Zhu Di launched the Jingnan Campaign, capturing Nanjing after four years to seize the throne.
description: 燕王朱棣以「清君侧」为名发动靖难之役，四年后攻入南京夺取皇位。
descriptionEn: Prince of Yan Zhu Di launched the Jingnan Campaign, capturing Nanjing after four years to seize the throne.

title: 迁都北京与永乐盛世
titleEn: Moving Capital to Beijing & Yongle Era
summary: 永乐帝迁都北京、五次亲征漠北、派郑和七下西洋、编纂《永乐大典》、修筑紫禁城。
summaryEn: Yongle moved the capital to Beijing, led five northern campaigns, dispatched Zheng He's voyages, compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia.
description: 永乐帝迁都北京、五次亲征漠北、派郑和七下西洋、编纂《永乐大典》、修筑紫禁城。
descriptionEn: Yongle moved the capital to Beijing, led five northern campaigns, dispatched Zheng He's voyages, compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia.

title: 于谦保卫北京
summary: 土木堡之变后于谦力排南迁之议，领导北京保卫战击退瓦剌大军，挽救了明朝。
summaryEn: After the Tumu Crisis, Yu Qian overrode calls to flee south, leading the defense of Beijing and saving the Ming dynasty.
description: 土木堡之变后于谦力排南迁之议，领导北京保卫战击退瓦剌大军，挽救了明朝。
descriptionEn: After the Tumu Crisis, Yu Qian overrode calls to flee south, leading the defense of Beijing and saving the Ming dynasty.

title: 明宣宗——仁宣之治
summary: 明宣宗延续仁政，裁撤冗员减轻赋税，宣德炉和宣德青花瓷至今仍是中国工艺美术的极致代表。
summaryEn: Xuande continued benevolent policies, and Xuande-era bronzes and blue-and-white porcelain remain pinnacles of Chinese craft.
description: 明宣宗延续仁政，裁撤冗员减轻赋税，宣德炉和宣德青花瓷至今仍是中国工艺美术的极致代表。
descriptionEn: Xuande continued benevolent policies, and Xuande-era bronzes and blue-and-white porcelain remain pinnacles of Chinese craft.

title: 唐伯虎——从解元到落魄才子
titleEn: Tang Yin: From Top Scholar to Fallen Genius
summary: 唐寅乡试第一风光无限，但次年卷入科场舞弊案被终身剥夺考试资格，从此靠卖画为生。
summaryEn: Tang Yin placed first in provincial exams, but was banned for life after a cheating scandal, becoming a painter for hire.
description: 唐寅乡试第一风光无限，但次年卷入科场舞弊案被终身剥夺考试资格，从此靠卖画为生。
descriptionEn: Tang Yin placed first in provincial exams, but was banned for life after a cheating scandal, becoming a painter for hire.

title: 王阳明龙场悟道
summary: 王阳明被贬贵州龙场驿，在困顿中顿悟「心即是理」，开创了心学。
summaryEn: Exiled to Longchang, Guizhou, Wang Yangming had his breakthrough: 'The mind is principle' — founding the School of Mind.
description: 王阳明被贬贵州龙场驿，在困顿中顿悟「心即是理」，开创了心学。
descriptionEn: Exiled to Longchang, Guizhou, Wang Yangming had his breakthrough: 'The mind is principle' — founding the School of Mind.

title: 王阳明平定宁王之乱
titleEn: Wang Yangming Suppresses Prince of Ning
summary: 宁王朱宸濠在南昌叛乱，王阳明以临时拼凑的兵力仅43天就平定叛乱。
summaryEn: When Prince of Ning rebelled, Wang Yangming crushed the rebellion in just 43 days with hastily assembled forces.
description: 宁王朱宸濠在南昌叛乱，王阳明以临时拼凑的兵力仅43天就平定叛乱。
descriptionEn: When Prince of Ning rebelled, Wang Yangming crushed the rebellion in just 43 days with hastily assembled forces.

title: 吴承恩著《西游记》
titleEn: Wu Chengen Writes Journey to the West
summary: 吴承恩在晚年创作了中国最伟大的神魔小说《西游记》，孙悟空成为中国文化最深入人心的形象之一。
summaryEn: Wu Chengen wrote Journey to the West, China's greatest mythological novel, creating the immortal Monkey King.
description: 吴承恩在晚年创作了中国最伟大的神魔小说《西游记》，孙悟空成为中国文化最深入人心的形象之一。
descriptionEn: Wu Chengen wrote Journey to the West, China's greatest mythological novel, creating the immortal Monkey King.

title: 海瑞上《治安疏》
summary: 海瑞备好棺材上《治安疏》痛斥嘉靖帝迷信道教不理朝政，成为中国历史上最著名的谏臣。
summaryEn: Hai Rui prepared his coffin and submitted a memorial harshly criticizing the Jiajing Emperor, becoming China's most famous remonstrator.
description: 海瑞备好棺材上《治安疏》痛斥嘉靖帝迷信道教不理朝政，成为中国历史上最著名的谏臣。
descriptionEn: Hai Rui prepared his coffin and submitted a memorial harshly criticizing the Jiajing Emperor, becoming China's most famous remonstrator.

title: 徐渭——最不幸的天才
titleEn: Xu Wei: The Most Unfortunate Genius
summary: 徐渭八次科举不第，一度精神失常九次自杀未遂，但在痛苦中开创了泼墨大写意花鸟画。
summaryEn: Xu Wei failed the exams eight times, went insane and attempted suicide nine times, yet pioneered splash-ink flower painting.
description: 徐渭八次科举不第，一度精神失常九次自杀未遂，但在痛苦中开创了泼墨大写意花鸟画。
descriptionEn: Xu Wei failed the exams eight times, went insane and attempted suicide nine times, yet pioneered splash-ink flower painting.

title: 张居正改革
summary: 张居正任首辅推行一条鞭法等重大改革，使明朝财政好转，是明朝最有权势的首辅。
summaryEn: Zhang Juzheng as Grand Secretary implemented the Single Whip Law and other reforms, reviving Ming finances.
description: 张居正任首辅推行一条鞭法等重大改革，使明朝财政好转，是明朝最有权势的首辅。
descriptionEn: Zhang Juzheng as Grand Secretary implemented the Single Whip Law and other reforms, reviving Ming finances.

title: 戚继光抗倭
summary: 戚继光组建戚家军，在东南沿海九战九捷基本肃清倭患，著有《纪效新书》和《练兵实纪》。
summaryEn: Qi Jiguang formed the Qi Army, winning nine consecutive battles to clear the coast of pirates.
description: 戚继光组建戚家军，在东南沿海九战九捷基本肃清倭患，著有《纪效新书》和《练兵实纪》。
descriptionEn: Qi Jiguang formed the Qi Army, winning nine consecutive battles to clear the coast of pirates.

title: 万历怠政
summary: 明神宗万历帝前期有张居正辅政，后期因国本之争长达三十年不上朝，明朝由此走向衰败。
summaryEn: Emperor Wanli, after Zhang Juzheng's death, refused to hold court for 30 years over a succession dispute.
description: 明神宗万历帝前期有张居正辅政，后期因国本之争长达三十年不上朝，明朝由此走向衰败。
descriptionEn: Emperor Wanli, after Zhang Juzheng's death, refused to hold court for 30 years over a succession dispute.

title: 宁远大捷
summary: 袁崇焕在宁远以红夷大炮命中努尔哈赤，后者不久伤重而死，是明军对后金的第一次重大胜利。
summaryEn: Yuan Chonghuan used Portuguese cannons at Ningyuan, mortally wounding Nurhaci — Ming's first major victory against the Later Jin.
description: 袁崇焕在宁远以红夷大炮命中努尔哈赤，后者不久伤重而死，是明军对后金的第一次重大胜利。
descriptionEn: Yuan Chonghuan used Portuguese cannons at Ningyuan, mortally wounding Nurhaci — Ming's first major victory against the Later Jin.

title: 袁崇焕被凌迟
summary: 皇太极利用反间计，多疑的崇祯帝将袁崇焕凌迟处死，北京百姓争食其肉——中国历史上最黑暗的忠臣悲剧之一。
summaryEn: Hong Taiji's disinformation led the paranoid Chongzhen Emperor to have Yuan Chonghuan executed by slow slicing — one of history's darkest loyalist tragedies.
description: 皇太极利用反间计，多疑的崇祯帝将袁崇焕凌迟处死，北京百姓争食其肉——中国历史上最黑暗的忠臣悲剧之一。
descriptionEn: Hong Taiji's disinformation led the paranoid Chongzhen Emperor to have Yuan Chonghuan executed by slow slicing — one of history's darkest loyalist tragedies.

title: 宋应星著《天工开物》
summary: 宋应星编著《天工开物》——中国第一部综合性工业技术百科全书，记录了明代的农业和手工业技术。
summaryEn: Song Yingxing compiled Tiangong Kaiwu — China's first comprehensive encyclopedia of industrial technology.
description: 宋应星编著《天工开物》——中国第一部综合性工业技术百科全书，记录了明代的农业和手工业技术。
descriptionEn: Song Yingxing compiled Tiangong Kaiwu — China's first comprehensive encyclopedia of industrial technology.

title: 崇祯帝煤山自缢
summary: 李自成攻破北京，崇祯帝在煤山自缢身亡，明朝灭亡。死前写下「任贼分裂朕尸，勿伤百姓一人」。
summaryEn: Li Zicheng captured Beijing; the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself on Coal Hill, ending the Ming dynasty.
description: 李自成攻破北京，崇祯帝在煤山自缢身亡，明朝灭亡。死前写下「任贼分裂朕尸，勿伤百姓一人」。
descriptionEn: Li Zicheng captured Beijing; the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself on Coal Hill, ending the Ming dynasty.

title: 皇太极建立大清
titleEn: Hong Taiji Proclaims the Qing Dynasty
summary: 皇太极在盛京称帝改国号为「大清」，改革八旗制度、重用汉人降将，做好了入主中原的一切准备。
summaryEn: Hong Taiji proclaimed the Qing dynasty at Shengjing, reformed the Banner system, and prepared for the conquest of China.
description: 皇太极在盛京称帝改国号为「大清」，改革八旗制度、重用汉人降将，做好了入主中原的一切准备。
descriptionEn: Hong Taiji proclaimed the Qing dynasty at Shengjing, reformed the Banner system, and prepared for the conquest of China.

title: 八大山人的白眼鱼鸟
titleEn: Ba Da Shanren's Scornful Fish and Birds
summary: 明宗室后裔朱耷出家为僧，以翻白眼的鱼鸟和大面积留白表达亡国之痛。
summaryEn: Zhu Da, Ming imperial descendant turned monk, expressed his grief through fish and birds with scornful white eyes.
description: 明宗室后裔朱耷出家为僧，以翻白眼的鱼鸟和大面积留白表达亡国之痛。
descriptionEn: Zhu Da, Ming imperial descendant turned monk, expressed his grief through fish and birds with scornful white eyes.

title: 清军入关
summary: 吴三桂引清兵入关，清军迅速占领北京并迁都，开始了清朝对中国的统治。
summaryEn: Wu Sangui opened Shanhai Pass; Qing forces quickly captured Beijing and moved the capital, beginning Qing rule over China.
description: 吴三桂引清兵入关，清军迅速占领北京并迁都，开始了清朝对中国的统治。
descriptionEn: Wu Sangui opened Shanhai Pass; Qing forces quickly captured Beijing and moved the capital, beginning Qing rule over China.

title: 蒲松龄著《聊斋志异》
summary: 蒲松龄科举屡试不第，在乡村教书之余搜集民间鬼狐故事，著成中国最伟大的文言短篇小说集。
summaryEn: Failing the exams repeatedly, Pu Songling collected ghost and fox spirit tales, creating China's greatest classical short story collection.
description: 蒲松龄科举屡试不第，在乡村教书之余搜集民间鬼狐故事，著成中国最伟大的文言短篇小说集。
descriptionEn: Failing the exams repeatedly, Pu Songling collected ghost and fox spirit tales, creating China's greatest classical short story collection.

title: 雍正帝改革
summary: 雍正帝推行摊丁入亩、耗羡归公、改土归流等重大改革，设立军机处强化皇权，是清朝最有效率的皇帝。
summaryEn: Yongzheng implemented sweeping fiscal and administrative reforms, establishing the Grand Council and strengthening imperial power.
description: 雍正帝推行摊丁入亩、耗羡归公、改土归流等重大改革，设立军机处强化皇权，是清朝最有效率的皇帝。
descriptionEn: Yongzheng implemented sweeping fiscal and administrative reforms, establishing the Grand Council and strengthening imperial power.

title: 郑板桥——扬州八怪之首
titleEn: Zheng Banqiao: Leader of the Eight Eccentrics
summary: 郑板桥以画竹闻名，题诗「衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声」表达对百姓的深切关怀。
summaryEn: Zheng Banqiao, famed for bamboo paintings, wrote: 'Lying in my office, I hear the rustling bamboo — could it be the sound of the people's suffering?'
description: 郑板桥以画竹闻名，题诗「衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声」表达对百姓的深切关怀。
descriptionEn: Zheng Banqiao, famed for bamboo paintings, wrote: 'Lying in my office, I hear the rustling bamboo — could it be the sound of the people's suffering?'

title: 刘墉——浓墨宰相
summary: 刘墉是乾隆朝名臣，以书法和清廉著称，民间传说中「刘罗锅」形象深入人心。
summaryEn: Liu Yong was a famed Qianlong-era official, renowned for his calligraphy and incorruptibility.
description: 刘墉是乾隆朝名臣，以书法和清廉著称，民间传说中「刘罗锅」形象深入人心。
descriptionEn: Liu Yong was a famed Qianlong-era official, renowned for his calligraphy and incorruptibility.

title: 纪晓岚编纂《四库全书》
summary: 纪晓岚任《四库全书》总纂官，历时十年完成这部中国历史上规模最大的丛书。
summaryEn: Ji Xiaolan served as chief editor of the Siku Quanshu, completing the largest book collection in Chinese history over ten years.
description: 纪晓岚任《四库全书》总纂官，历时十年完成这部中国历史上规模最大的丛书。
descriptionEn: Ji Xiaolan served as chief editor of the Siku Quanshu, completing the largest book collection in Chinese history over ten years.

title: 林则徐虎门销烟
titleEn: Lin Zexu Destroys Opium at Humen
summary: 林则徐在虎门海滩当众销毁英国鸦片两万余箱，成为中国近代史上最壮烈的抵抗外来侵略的象征。
summaryEn: Lin Zexu publicly destroyed over 20,000 chests of British opium at Humen Beach, becoming a national hero.
description: 林则徐在虎门海滩当众销毁英国鸦片两万余箱，成为中国近代史上最壮烈的抵抗外来侵略的象征。
descriptionEn: Lin Zexu publicly destroyed over 20,000 chests of British opium at Humen Beach, becoming a national hero.

title: 曾国藩平定太平天国
summary: 曾国藩组建湘军，经过十余年苦战最终攻破天京平定太平天国，挽救了清朝。
summaryEn: Zeng Guofan raised the Hunan Army and after a decade of bitter warfare captured Nanjing, crushing the Taiping Rebellion.
description: 曾国藩组建湘军，经过十余年苦战最终攻破天京平定太平天国，挽救了清朝。
descriptionEn: Zeng Guofan raised the Hunan Army and after a decade of bitter warfare captured Nanjing, crushing the Taiping Rebellion.

title: 左宗棠收复新疆
summary: 左宗棠抬棺出征收复新疆，粉碎了阿古柏分裂政权，为中华民族保住了六分之一的国土。
summaryEn: Zuo Zongtang marched west with his coffin, recovering Xinjiang from Yakub Beg and preserving one-sixth of China's territory.
description: 左宗棠抬棺出征收复新疆，粉碎了阿古柏分裂政权，为中华民族保住了六分之一的国土。
descriptionEn: Zuo Zongtang marched west with his coffin, recovering Xinjiang from Yakub Beg and preserving one-sixth of China's territory.

title: 戊戌变法
summary: 光绪帝和康有为梁启超推动103天改革，企图将中国从君主专制转向君主立宪，被慈禧政变镇压。
summaryEn: Emperor Guangxu with Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao launched 103 days of reforms, crushed by Empress Dowager Cixi's coup.
description: 光绪帝和康有为梁启超推动103天改革，企图将中国从君主专制转向君主立宪，被慈禧政变镇压。
descriptionEn: Emperor Guangxu with Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao launched 103 days of reforms, crushed by Empress Dowager Cixi's coup.

title: 溥仪退位——清朝灭亡
titleEn: Puyi Abdicates: End of Qing Dynasty
summary: 辛亥革命后六岁的溥仪颁布退位诏书，清朝灭亡，中国两千多年的帝制终结。
summaryEn: After the Xinhai Revolution, the six-year-old Puyi issued the abdication edict, ending both the Qing dynasty and imperial China.
description: 辛亥革命后六岁的溥仪颁布退位诏书，清朝灭亡，中国两千多年的帝制终结。
descriptionEn: After the Xinhai Revolution, the six-year-old Puyi issued the abdication edict, ending both the Qing dynasty and imperial China.
